s-18-01-anatomy.alt: Anatomy of a button, drawn from its code to copy on Newsprint, with seven numbered callouts and a key. 1, Word: What the button does, in a word or a few; the button’s name starts with it. 2, Focus ring: The code’s own 2 px ring at a 2 px gap, drawn at once. 3, Fill or edge: A primary button is filled; a quiet one draws a 1 px edge in the strong border color. 4, Height: At least 44 px tall and 44 px wide. 5, Utility icon: 24 px, before or after the word, in the word’s ink. 6, Unavailable: A dashed edge and the disabled label color; it keeps its focus. 7, Reason line: Says what makes the button available, and the button points to it.
s-18-01-anatomy.notes: Drawn from work/build/guide/code/c-18-button.html and .css by stage_c_ch18_anatomy_build.py: the parts the caption names, as a picture (AX-S8), with the code’s own states set by attribute and its class names shortened (D2-1366).

s-18-02-anatomy.alt: Anatomy of a chip, on and off, drawn from its code to copy on Newsprint, with five numbered callouts and a key. 1, Height: 44 px tall and at least 44 px wide. 2, On: check and bold word: The selected check, 24 px, before the word, and the word in bold. 3, On: 2 px edge: In the strong border color; the fill stays the ground. 4, Off: word: The same word at 600, the weight every control’s word takes, with no check. 5, Off: 1 px edge: The chip’s edge when it is off.
s-18-02-anatomy.notes: Drawn from work/build/guide/code/c-18-toggle.html and .css by stage_c_ch18_anatomy_build.py: the parts the caption names, as a picture (AX-S8), with the code’s own states set by attribute and its class names shortened (D2-1366).

s-18-03-anatomy.alt: Anatomy of a choice of one of a few, drawn from its code to copy on Newsprint, with seven numbered callouts and a key. 1, Legend: Names the group, and a screen reader says it on entering. 2, Height: Each segment 44 px tall, and all of it is the label. 3, Checked: The selected check before the word, the word in bold and a 2 px edge. 4, Focus ring: Around the whole segment of the radio button in focus. 5, Segment: A choice not taken: its word inside a 1 px edge. 6, Waiting: A choice that cannot be taken yet: a dashed edge and the disabled color. 7, Reason line: Says why that choice waits.
s-18-03-anatomy.notes: Drawn from work/build/guide/code/c-18-choice.html and .css by stage_c_ch18_anatomy_build.py: the parts the caption names, as a picture (AX-S8), with the code’s own states set by attribute and its class names shortened (D2-1366).

s-18-04-anatomy.alt: Anatomy of the theme switch, drawn from its code to copy on Newsprint, with five numbered callouts and a key. 1, Its place: At the top of the phone menu, under its title, or in the masthead, in the same place on every page. 2, Legend: The word Theme names the group of three. 3, Height: Each segment 44 px tall. 4, A choice: Light, Dark and Match my device, each its word inside a 1 px edge. 5, Checked: Match my device, checked at first: the selected check, the word in bold and a 2 px edge.
s-18-04-anatomy.notes: Drawn from work/build/guide/code/c-18-masthead.html and .css, work/build/guide/code/c-18-theme-switch.html and .css by stage_c_ch18_anatomy_build.py: the parts the caption names, as a picture (AX-S8), with the code’s own states set by attribute and its class names shortened (D2-1366).

s-18-05-anatomy.alt: Anatomy of links, drawn from its code to copy on Newsprint, with five numbered callouts and a key. 1, Skip link: Hidden until the Tab key reaches it first on a page, then shown at the top. 2, Words: Say where the link goes, and make sense read on their own. 3, Underline: 1 px at rest, 2 px under a pointer, as here. 4, Link to another site: Its name ends with the hidden words (another site) for a screen reader. 5, Mark: The 16 px mark for another site, after the last word, which it never leaves.
s-18-05-anatomy.notes: Drawn from work/build/guide/code/c-18-link.html and .css by stage_c_ch18_anatomy_build.py: the parts the caption names, as a picture (AX-S8), with the code’s own states set by attribute and its class names shortened (D2-1366). The skip link is drawn in place above the text, and the lines are spaced apart to leave room for the callouts.

s-18-06-anatomy.alt: Anatomy of a masthead and its phone menu, drawn from its code to copy on Newsprint, with nine numbered callouts and a key. 1, Home link: The product’s name, from the wordmark’s master, links to the front page. 2, Navigation: Named Parts of the site; with 40rem of room it sits in the bar in place of Menu. 3, Current part: Bold, with a 2 px underline. 4, Height: Each link and Menu at least 44 px tall; Close the menu 44 by 44 px. 5, Menu: Under 40rem: three bars and the word, which opens the menu over the page. 6, Open menu: Its title, in a dialog that holds focus until it closes. 7, Close the menu: The cross and its words; Escape closes it too, and focus returns to Menu. 8, Current row: The selected band, a 4 px bar and bold words. 9, Row: Each part again, 44 px tall.
s-18-06-anatomy.notes: Drawn from work/build/guide/code/c-18-masthead.html and .css by stage_c_ch18_anatomy_build.py: the parts the caption names, as a picture (AX-S8), with the code’s own states set by attribute and its class names shortened (D2-1366).

s-18-07-anatomy.alt: Anatomy of location lists, drawn from its code to copy on Newsprint, with five numbered callouts and a key. 1, Breadcrumb’s current page: The last step, in bold and not underlined; its link says it is the page. 2, Label: Names the list, as the navigation’s own name does. 3, Link: A place to go, with its words. 4, Height: Rows 44 px tall in a list a thumb uses. 5, Current place: The selected band, a 4 px bar drawn as a border, and bold words.
s-18-07-anatomy.notes: Drawn from work/build/guide/code/c-18-location.html and .css by stage_c_ch18_anatomy_build.py: the parts the caption names, as a picture (AX-S8), with the code’s own states set by attribute and its class names shortened (D2-1366).

s-18-08-anatomy.alt: Anatomy of a disclosure, open and closed, drawn from its code to copy on Newsprint, with six numbered callouts and a key. 1, Words: Name the part that opens. 2, Chevron up: While the part is open. 3, The part that opens: Shown in place, under its row. 4, Height: The row at least 44 px tall across its width. 5, Focus ring: Around the row in focus. 6, Chevron down: While the part is closed.
s-18-08-anatomy.notes: Drawn from work/build/guide/code/c-18-disclosure.html and .css by stage_c_ch18_anatomy_build.py: the parts the caption names, as a picture (AX-S8), with the code’s own states set by attribute and its class names shortened (D2-1366).

s-18-09-anatomy.alt: Anatomy of tabs, drawn from its code to copy on Newsprint, with seven numbered callouts and a key. 1, Tab list: Named Views of the bill; the Tab key enters at the selected tab, and the arrow keys move. 2, Height: Each tab 44 px tall. 3, Selected tab: A 4 px bar and bold words; its panel shows at once. 4, Focus ring: On the tab in focus. 5, Tab: A view’s name in a word or two. 6, Unavailable tab: Dashed, with the reason under the list. 7, Panel: The selected tab’s view, named by its tab.
s-18-09-anatomy.notes: Drawn from work/build/guide/code/c-18-tabs.html and .css by stage_c_ch18_anatomy_build.py: the parts the caption names, as a picture (AX-S8), with the code’s own states set by attribute and its class names shortened (D2-1366).

s-18-10-anatomy.alt: Anatomy of a sortable table, drawn from its code to copy on Newsprint, with five numbered callouts and a key. 1, Caption: Names the table, as table markup’s own caption. 2, Column heading: Each heading holds a sort button with its words and a 16 px arrow. 3, Height: Each sort button at least 44 px tall, across its words and arrow. 4, Sorted heading: The arrow turned to the order, and the heading says it in aria-sort. 5, Row rule: A hairline between rows, drawn as a border.
s-18-10-anatomy.notes: Drawn from work/build/guide/code/c-18-table.html and .css by stage_c_ch18_anatomy_build.py: the parts the caption names, as a picture (AX-S8), with the code’s own states set by attribute and its class names shortened (D2-1366). The status line under the table is written by its script when a reader sorts; the plate shows the table at rest.

s-18-11-anatomy.alt: Anatomy of a scroll region, drawn from its code to copy on Newsprint, with five numbered callouts and a key. 1, Name: Names the frame, and the frame takes it. 2, Hint: Shown only while the content is wider than the frame. 3, Frame: A hairline edge; the content scrolls inside it, so the page never does. 4, Wide content: Its own width, cut by the frame’s edge. 5, Focus ring: Drawn around the frame; the frame is a Tab stop only while it scrolls, and the arrow keys move it.
s-18-11-anatomy.notes: Drawn from work/build/guide/code/c-18-scroll-region.html and .css by stage_c_ch18_anatomy_build.py: the parts the caption names, as a picture (AX-S8), with the code’s own states set by attribute and its class names shortened (D2-1366).

s-18-12-anatomy.alt: Anatomy of a code block, drawn from its code to copy on Newsprint, with six numbered callouts and a key. 1, Panel label: The file’s kind, HTML, CSS or Script. 2, Height: Each Copy button 44 px tall. 3, Copy button: Named for what it copies, Copy the HTML, and described by the block’s name. 4, Code: At 14 px in the code face, scrolling inside its panel. 5, Status line: The success mark and what was copied, in words. 6, Copy refused: The error mark, Error:, the Error Band and the 4 px bar, with the code selected.
s-18-12-anatomy.notes: Drawn from work/build/guide/code/c-18-code-block.html and .css by stage_c_ch18_anatomy_build.py: the parts the caption names, as a picture (AX-S8), with the code’s own states set by attribute and its class names shortened (D2-1366). The code is cut at the panel’s edge, as it draws before a reader scrolls it.

s-18-13-anatomy.alt: Anatomy of a copy control, drawn from its code to copy on Newsprint, with four numbered callouts and a key. 1, Value: The value to copy, in the code face, beside what it is. 2, Size: At least 44 by 44 px, even beside a short value. 3, Copy button: The two-sheet icon and the word Copy; hidden words finish its name with what it copies. 4, Status line: The success mark and what was copied, in words; the icon never turns into a check.
s-18-13-anatomy.notes: Drawn from work/build/guide/code/c-18-copy.html and .css by stage_c_ch18_anatomy_build.py: the parts the caption names, as a picture (AX-S8), with the code’s own states set by attribute and its class names shortened (D2-1366).

s-18-14-anatomy.alt: Anatomy of a download, drawn from its code to copy on Newsprint, with five numbered callouts and a key. 1, Height: 44 px tall. 2, Icon: The download arrow into a tray, 24 px, before the word. 3, Words: From Download to the file, its type and its size. 4, Not ready: A dashed edge and the disabled color; it keeps its focus. 5, Reason line: Says when the file comes.
s-18-14-anatomy.notes: Drawn from work/build/guide/code/c-18-download.html and .css by stage_c_ch18_anatomy_build.py: the parts the caption names, as a picture (AX-S8), with the code’s own states set by attribute and its class names shortened (D2-1366).

s-18-15-anatomy.alt: Anatomy of a search, drawn from its code to copy on Newsprint, with five numbered callouts and a key. 1, Label: Above the field, always shown; a placeholder never stands in for it. 2, Height: The field 44 px tall; Clear the search 44 by 44 px. 3, Field: Its edge on the field ground, with the magnifier before the text. 4, Clear the search: The cross, once there is text; Escape clears it too. 5, Status line: The count, and when nothing matches, the advice in the same line.
s-18-15-anatomy.notes: Drawn from work/build/guide/code/c-18-search.html and .css by stage_c_ch18_anatomy_build.py: the parts the caption names, as a picture (AX-S8), with the code’s own states set by attribute and its class names shortened (D2-1366).

s-18-16-anatomy.alt: Anatomy of a filter bar, drawn from its code to copy on Newsprint, with seven numbered callouts and a key. 1, Height: 44 px tall for Filters, each chip and Clear filters. 2, Filters: The funnel, the word and a chevron that points up while the filters are open. 3, Count: How many filters are on, in the button’s own name. 4, Clear filters: Shown only while a filter is on; focus moves to Filters after it. 5, Chip on: The selected check, the word in bold and a 2 px edge. 6, Chip off: Its word inside a 1 px edge. 7, Status line: The count the filters leave, shared with the search.
s-18-16-anatomy.notes: Drawn from work/build/guide/code/c-18-filter-bar.html and .css by stage_c_ch18_anatomy_build.py: the parts the caption names, as a picture (AX-S8), with the code’s own states set by attribute and its class names shortened (D2-1366).

s-18-17-anatomy.alt: Anatomy of a form field, in error and after a send, drawn from its code to copy on Newsprint, with eight numbered callouts and a key. 1, Label: Above its field, always shown. 2, Field in error: The 4 px red bar on its edge, drawn as a border, and it points to its message. 3, Error mark and Error:: The mark in the text’s ink, then Error:. 4, The fix: On the Error Band with its own 4 px bar, in plain words. 5, Hint: Under the label, read with the field. 6, Height: Fields and the send button at least 44 px tall. 7, Send: While an error holds the red, the ask steps down to the primary button. 8, Success line: After a send that works: the success mark and what happens next.
s-18-17-anatomy.notes: Drawn from work/build/guide/code/c-18-form.html and .css by stage_c_ch18_anatomy_build.py: the parts the caption names, as a picture (AX-S8), with the code’s own states set by attribute and its class names shortened (D2-1366).

s-18-18-anatomy.alt: Anatomy of messages, drawn from its code to copy on Newsprint, with six numbered callouts and a key. 1, Mark: 24 px: the error mark in the text’s ink. 2, First word: Error:, Warning: or what happened, in bold. 3, Error Band: Behind an error on Newsprint; none on Charcoal. 4, Bar: 4 px, drawn as a border: Pillar Red for an error. 5, Warning: The warning mark and a 4 px bar, both in the text’s ink. 6, Success: The success mark in Verdigris, with no bar.
s-18-18-anatomy.notes: Drawn from work/build/guide/code/c-18-messages.html and .css by stage_c_ch18_anatomy_build.py: the parts the caption names, as a picture (AX-S8), with the code’s own states set by attribute and its class names shortened (D2-1366).

s-18-19-anatomy.alt: Anatomy of loading and empty, drawn from its code to copy on Newsprint, with four numbered callouts and a key. 1, Still drawing: An outline that never pulses or turns. 2, Loading words: Say what is loading, in a status line. 3, Empty region: A dashed edge around the words. 4, What to do next: What is missing, then what to do to fill it.
s-18-19-anatomy.notes: Drawn from work/build/guide/code/c-18-loading-empty.html and .css by stage_c_ch18_anatomy_build.py: the parts the caption names, as a picture (AX-S8), with the code’s own states set by attribute and its class names shortened (D2-1366). The code set’s empty state names its next step in words and holds no control yet; the caption’s control waits on the set.

s-18-20-anatomy.alt: Anatomy of a live tracker, drawn from its code to copy on Newsprint, with six numbered callouts and a key. 1, Bill: Its number and title. 2, Done: A filled step with its number and state word, Filed. 3, Now: The step under way, its ring and its word; here a reader can take part. 4, Not yet: A fine ring and its word. 5, Status line: Says each change once, politely, in words. 6, Check date: The warning mark and when we last checked.
s-18-20-anatomy.notes: Drawn from work/build/guide/code/c-18-tracker.html and .css by stage_c_ch18_anatomy_build.py: the parts the caption names, as a picture (AX-S8), with the code’s own states set by attribute and its class names shortened (D2-1366).

s-18-21-anatomy.alt: Anatomy of a report reader, drawn from its code to copy on Newsprint, with seven numbered callouts and a key. 1, Page view: The page as readable text, fitted to the width. 2, Status line: The page number and title, said once on each turn. 3, Height: 44 px tall. 4, Unavailable: Previous page on the first page: a dashed edge, and it keeps its focus. 5, Next page: Its word and the arrow after it. 6, Reason line: Says why Previous page waits. 7, Page size: Fit width or Full size, a choice of one, the checked one with its check.
s-18-21-anatomy.notes: Drawn from work/build/guide/code/c-18-report-reader.html and .css by stage_c_ch18_anatomy_build.py: the parts the caption names, as a picture (AX-S8), with the code’s own states set by attribute and its class names shortened (D2-1366).

s-18-22-anatomy.alt: Anatomy of a loop stepper, drawn from its code to copy on Newsprint, with eight numbered callouts and a key. 1, Live line: Each step, said once, politely. 2, Current step: A 4 px bar drawn as a border, in the step list. 3, Height: 44 px tall. 4, Play: Its icon and word; Pause while it runs, Play again at the end. 5, Reset the loop: The open circle with one arrowhead, and its words. 6, Previous step: The arrow mirrored, before the words. 7, Next step, unavailable: At the last step: a dashed edge, and it keeps its focus. 8, Reason line: Says why Next step waits and what to do.
s-18-22-anatomy.notes: Drawn from work/build/guide/code/c-18-loop-stepper.html and .css by stage_c_ch18_anatomy_build.py: the parts the caption names, as a picture (AX-S8), with the code’s own states set by attribute and its class names shortened (D2-1366). Drawn at the last step, the state the stepper script writes there.

s-18-23-anatomy.alt: Anatomy of diagram controls, drawn from its code to copy on Newsprint, with seven numbered callouts and a key. 1, Height: Each item at least 44 px tall on a phone. 2, Item in focus: Its heavier mark and underlined label; the arrow keys move between items. 3, Selected item: The selected check, bold words and a 2 px edge. 4, Muted item: While another is selected: the muted edge and words. 5, Readout line: The item in focus in words, as focus moves. 6, Panel: Its title takes focus; Escape closes it and focus returns to the item. 7, The lines in words: A disclosure that gives the drawing as sentences.
s-18-23-anatomy.notes: Drawn from work/build/guide/code/c-18-diagram-controls.html and .css by stage_c_ch18_anatomy_build.py: the parts the caption names, as a picture (AX-S8), with the code’s own states set by attribute and its class names shortened (D2-1366). The code set holds the disclosure for the lines in words; a disclosure that shows the drawing as a table waits on the set.

s-18-24-anatomy.alt: Anatomy of typed ID chips, drawn from its code to copy on Newsprint, with five numbered callouts and a key. 1, Type word: Loop, Variable, Reform or Domain, before the code. 2, Code: The atlas ID, in tabular figures. 3, Edge: A hairline in the strong border color. 4, Target: As a link, at least 24 px tall. 5, As a link: It opens the record; its words keep a 1 px underline, 2 px under a pointer, as here.
s-18-24-anatomy.notes: Drawn from work/build/guide/code/c-18-id-chip.html and .css by stage_c_ch18_anatomy_build.py: the parts the caption names, as a picture (AX-S8), with the code’s own states set by attribute and its class names shortened (D2-1366).
